name: cpu_status
description: CPU LoadPercentage（使用率%）を Windows CIM から実測し、文字列として status キーに返す Legacy Tool。CPUモデル・コア数・温度は返さない — 必要なら get_cpu_status（別Tool案）を検討。
purpose: Windows PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor から LoadPercentage のみ取得し {status: string} で返す — Legacy 互換を v2 spec で固定

environment_dependencies.provider_strategy: A — single Tool, Windows CIM provider only
environment_dependencies.non_windows: unsupported — no Linux implementation in v2 baseline

model.evidence: PROBED via CIM on audit host

temperature.evidence: CIM Win32_Processor alone — not PROBED as available

observation_semantics.observed: status contains numeric LoadPercentage string from CIM

unknown_semantics.note: cpu_status v2 does not emit unknown string for load — uses error status instead

unsupported_semantics.non_windows: Tool not specified for Linux/macOS in v2 baseline

status.naming_note: Key name 'status' is legacy — semantically LoadPercentage not general health

ok.cross_tool_gap: GPU tools have ok; cpu_status does not

known_limitations: LoadPercentage only — not full CPU status
No ok/error/observation_source in output — OBSERVED GAP vs GPU tools

compatibility_notes.v1_legacy_migrated: output schema unchanged — single status key
compatibility_notes.extension_policy: Adding keys to cpu_status requires HR — prefer get_cpu_status new tool
compatibility_notes.breaking_change_policy: Changing status meaning from LoadPercentage forbidden

validation_requirements: E2E det_case3 routes to cpu_status not get_gpu_processes

llm_rules: Do not invent cores/model from status alone

must: preserve status-only output in v2 baseline
must_not: change status semantic to general health object
